# DISCOVER DARGLOBAL
DarGlobal > About Us > DISCOVER DARGLOBAL > Overview / Data. Privacy Policy
Introduction
DarGlobal is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit https://www.darglobal.co.uk without disclosing your identity information.
This Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
Acceptance
By using this site, you agree with the DarGlobal Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of DarGlobal website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy.
Information
You may have to register certain information with us to use our services available on this site. The following forms are available on this site to collect personal data that you chose to register to avail of certain services:
EMAIL REGISTRATION Information about DarGlobal, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
CONTACT US The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.darglobal.co.uk, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
RESIDENTIAL UNIT RESERVATION FORM The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned property upon customer request.
CREDIT INFORMATION Relevant information about the credit policy of DarGlobal will be provided to the customer upon request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.
Cookies
Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies

DarGlobal > About Us > DISCOVER DARGLOBAL > Overview / Data. We may collect personal information from you when you use, including but not limited to, the contact options and e-mail. In addition to the personal information we collect, the website server will automatically recognize and store your internet address. In addition, this website may use cookies. Most web browsers are set by default to accept cookies; however, you may set your browser to either accept or refuse cookies. Cookies help websites keep track of personal preferences and recognize return visitors. The cookies are not designed to collect or store information on you, but to deliver targeted content to you online.
Information Safety​
How safe will my information be?
The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.darglobal.co.uk, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, DarGlobal cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, DarGlobal uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
Information Usage
Who will use this information?
The general rule is that DarGlobal will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the nature of our relationship or the law requires it.

## FAQ
Q: What is AIDA by DarGlobal and what makes this development unique?
A: AIDA is a fully master-planned destination in Muscat, Oman, designed as a city within a city. Developed by DarGlobal, it combines luxury residences, branded hotels, golf courses, nature, and lifestyle amenities in one integrated community.

Q: Where is AIDA located in Oman?
A: AIDA is in Muscat, Oman, about 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, elevated 130 meters above sea level along the coastline, offering scenic views.

Q: Can international buyers own property at AIDA?
A: Yes. AIDA offers 100% foreign ownership within designated investment zones, ideal for investors and second-home buyers.

Q: How can I register my interest or book a viewing at AIDA?
A: You can register your interest through our website or by visiting one of our offices.
If you are outside Oman, the sales team will contact you and arrange the most suitable way to connect.
If you are in Oman or planning a visit, you can visit the office and enjoy a private, one on one site tour, including a visit to the development, the views, and the latest construction updates.

Q: What types of properties are available at AIDA?
A: AIDA offers apartments, luxury villas, hotel residences, and branded or non-branded residences. Explore your options for investment or lifestyle living.

Q: Are there branded residences at AIDA?
A: Yes. AIDA features branded residences in collaboration with internationally recognized brands, including Trump and Marriott.

Q: Does property ownership include golf access?
A: Golf access is available through membership at Trump International Golf Club Oman, subject to application and approval.

Q: Who is developing AIDA in Oman?
A: AIDA is a master plan developed by DarGlobal in partnership with OMRAN, collaborating with global brands such as the Trump Organization and Marriott.

Q: What makes AIDA a city within a city?
A: AIDA offers residential living, hospitality, leisure, wellness, retail, and outdoor experiences all in one destination, allowing residents to live, relax, and socialize without leaving the community.

Q: Is AIDA a gated community in Muscat, Oman?
A: Yes. AIDA is a private, gated community in Muscat offering controlled access, security, and a secure residential environment designed for privacy and peace of mind.

Q: Who is AIDA designed for?
A: AIDA is designed for end users, second-home owners, and international investors seeking a luxury resort lifestyle, long-term value, and globally benchmarked living standards in Oman.

Q: How accessible is AIDA from the region?
A: AIDA is accessible with a 60-minute flight from Dubai and has strong connections to regional and international destinations.

Q: What views are available from properties at AIDA?
A: Homes at AIDA offer sea views, golf course views, or valley/wadi views. The master plan integrates natural landscapes with parks and elevated viewpoints.

Q: How is nature integrated into the master plan?
A: AIDA features landscaped parks, hiking and cycling trails, and outdoor adventure zones, blending luxury living with Oman’s natural environment.

Q: Is there a golf course at AIDA?
A: Yes, there is an 18-hole trump championship golf course.

Q: What is the AIDA Residence Club?
A: The AIDA Residence Club offers wellness, leisure, dining, and community facilities exclusively for residents.

Q: Is AIDA suitable for families?
A: Yes. AIDA is designed for families, with amenities and spaces suited for all age groups.

Q: Does owning property at AIDA provide residency benefits?
A: Eligible property ownership gives access to lifetime residency in Oman, subject to regulations.

Q: Are financing and payment plans available at AIDA?
A: Buyers can access mortgage solutions and structured payment plans, typically linked to construction milestones.

Q: Can I rent out my property at AIDA?
A: Yes. Approved properties can be rented on a short-term basis, with professional management services available.

Q: What amenities are available at AIDA?
A: Amenities include swimming pools, parks, wellness and fitness centers, restaurants, kids’ play areas, outdoor cinemas, and adventure zones.

Q: Are properties at AIDA managed?
A: Yes. Selected residences and hotel units are fully managed, including Trump International Hotel and Trump Cliff Villas, for hassle-free ownership.

Q: Is rental management available at AIDA?
A: Yes. Owners can opt for rental management services to generate income from eligible units.

Q: What are the key residences at AIDA?
A: AIDA includes Trump Golf Villas, Trump Cliff Villas, Fairway Villas, The Great Escape, Marriott Residences and more, each offering unique designs, views, and lifestyle benefits.

title: Trump Cliff Villas
full_text:
# Trump Cliff Villas

## Project details
- Country: Oman
- Location: Muscat, Oman
- Part of: AIDA
- Category: villas
- Property type: Furnished Residences
- Status: Under Development
- Unit type: 3 bedroom villas
- Area: 128 - 166 sqm
- Price: not published
- Developer partner: Trump

## About
Once in a Lifetime
Trump Cliff Villas is a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Positioned beside the Trump International Hotel, 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, each villa ranges from 128 to 166 sqm and features a private pool overlooking the sea. Owners receive a Golf Club Social Membership and the flexibility to reside in or lease the villa.

## Key features
- Trump 18-hole Championship Golf Course
- Trump Members Only Club
- The SHFT Night Club
- 5 stars Culinary Delights
- AIDA Beach
- Trump Hotels Hanging Suites

## Amenities
- Trump International Golf Club, Oman
- Community & Retail Centre
- Plazas, Cafes & Restaurants
- Wellness Centres
- Fitness Center
- Promenades
- Hiking Trail
- Mountain Bike
- Luxury Hotels
- Outdoor Landscapes
- Running Trail
- Viewing Deck

## Why INVEST
Oman is quickly becoming one of the most prominent commercial and cultural hubs in the region and is rapidly becoming a prime investment destination due to its attractive benefits. From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive.
- Life-time Residency Visa for ITC project investors
- Upcoming UAE-Muscat railway project
- 100% Freehold Ownership for all nationalities*
- 0% Personal Income tax
- 0% Capital Gains tax
- 0% Inheritance tax (inheritance laws of owner's country apply)
- 25 years exemption from corporate income taxes in special economic/free zones
- Stable and Growing Economy with low inflation
- One of the safest countries in the world
- Ideal Location with easy access to the Gulf, Indian subcontinent, and Africa
- Tourism Hub with projected earnings of $22.5bn by 2040
- Cosmopolitan community with over 100 nationalities
- The Quality of Life Index by Numbeo ranked Oman 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in 2023.
- Saudi-Oman Highway: Cuts travel by 16 hours, driving tourism and investment.
- Exclusive mortgage program in Oman for resident and non-resident buyers, designed to enhance real estate returns.

## Location
Located in Muscat and just 25 minutes from the international airport, AIDA rises 130 metres above sea level as a city within a city, combining nature, hospitality, and a championship golf destination.
- Trump 18-hole Championship Golf Course
- Trump Members Only Club
- The SHFT Night Club
- 5 stars Culinary Delights
- AIDA Beach
- Trump Hotels Hanging Suites

## FAQ
Q: What are Trump Cliff Villas at AIDA?
A: Trump Cliff Villas are a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom sea-view villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly beside the Trump International Hotel at 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with a private pool overlooking the sea. Villas are designed and furnished to the highest standard, with every detail specified down to specification.

Q: What are the villa sizes and unit types available?
A: Trump Cliff Villas offer three-bedroom furnished residences from 128 to 166 sqm. Each villa includes a private pool with sea views. Owners receive a Trump International Golf Club Social Membership as part of the purchase and have the option to reside in or lease the villa.

Q: What does the Trump Cliff Villas offer that other AIDA products do not?
A: Trump Cliff Villas offer full villa ownership with a private pool, the closest positioning to the Trump International Hotel, and the most elevated sea views on the AIDA estate. Unlike Trump Golf Villas, which face the golf course, These villas are positioned on the cliff edge with direct sea orientation. Both villa products sit within the same AIDA estate and share access to the same championship golf course and community facilities.

Q: What amenities are available to Trump Cliff Villa owners?
A: Within the AIDA estate, villa owners have access to the Trump International Golf Club Oman (18-hole championship course), Trump Members Only Club, The SHFT Night Club, 5-star dining and culinary facilities, AIDA Beach, Trump Hotels Hanging Suites, a Trump International Hotel lobby, community and retail centres, plazas, cafes and restaurants, wellness centres, fitness centre, promenades, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, viewing decks, and outdoor landscapes across the cliffside estate.

Q: When will Trump Cliff Villas be completed?
A: Completion is scheduled for December 2028. Construction is underway and live progress feeds are available on the DarGlobal project page. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to book a unit, choose your residence via the online navigator, or download the project brochure.

Q: Can I lease my Trump Cliff Villa when I am not using it?
A: Yes. The entry data states that owners have the choice to reside in or lease their villa. The Trump management association with the property supports the leasing proposition. Contact DarGlobal for further details on the leasing model and revenue arrangements.

Q: Can foreign nationals buy Trump Cliff Villas in Oman?
A: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. ITC project buyers are eligible for a lifetime residency visa in Oman. An exclusive mortgage program is available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers. Buyers should confirm specific eligibility conditions with DarGlobal or their legal advisor.

Q: What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman real estate?
A: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

Q: Why invest in Muscat property now?
A: Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries in the world. Tourism earnings are projected to exceed $22.5 billion per year by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time between the two countries by 16 hours, and an upcoming UAE-Muscat railway project will further strengthen connectivity and investment activity.

Q: How do Trump Cliff Villas relate to the wider AIDA development?
A: Trump Cliff Villas are one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal products at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman (hotel room ownership), Trump Golf Villas (five-bedroom fairway villas), Marriott Residences Aida, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a fully integrated branded resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

Q: Is Jeddah good for property investment? A: Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Villas and land plots, like those offered at Amaya, tend to appeal to buyers seeking long-term ownership and the option to customize their homes. For buyers considering the Gulf Cooperation Council region, Jeddah offers a relatively stable entry point into a maturing property market with room for continued growth. Q: Can I buy a plot at Amaya and build my own villa? A: Yes, Amaya offers land plots specifically for buyers who want to design and construct a custom villa rather than purchase a completed home. faqs.q: How much does a villa or plot in Jeddah cost?

faqs.q: Jeddah vs Riyadh — which is better to buy property?

faqs.q: What is the process for buying property in Jeddah?

faqs.q: What amenities are near Amaya?

faqs.q: Can I buy a plot at Amaya and build my own villa?

# Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE
DarGlobal > Newsroom > Blog > Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE > Part 1. In the azure waters of the Arabian Gulf, Al Marjan Island is a premier destination in Ras Al Khaimah (RAK), UAE, offering an exquisite blend of luxury, leisure, and natural beauty. This man-made archipelago, consisting of four coral-shaped islands, provides an idyllic setting for both residents and visitors seeking a unique lifestyle experience. From pristine beaches and luxury resorts to world-class entertainment and dining, Al Marjan Island is a haven for those who appreciate the finer things in life. A Paradise of Luxury Living Al Marjan Island is synonymous with luxury living. Its strategic location, just 60 minutes from Dubai, makes it a convenient retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. The island boasts a collection of high-end residential developments, luxury hotels, and resorts that cater to discerning tastes. Whether you are looking for a permanent residence or a vacation home, Al Marjan Island offers a range of properties that embody elegance and sophistication. Discover the Wonders of Al Marjan Island Al Marjan Island is not just about luxurious living; it is also a destination for leisure and entertainment. The island offers a plethora of attractions and activities that cater to every desire, making it a perfect getaway for families, couples, and solo travelers. The WYNN Resort and Casino

DarGlobal > Newsroom > Blog > Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE > Part 2. One of the most anticipated attractions on Al Marjan Island is the upcoming WYNN Resort and Casino. This world-class entertainment complex will be the first casino in the UAE, bringing a new level of excitement to the island. The WYNN Resort will offer a range of gaming options, luxury accommodations, fine dining, and entertainment, making it a premier destination for those seeking an upscale and thrilling experience. Pristine Beaches and Marine Activities Al Marjan Island is renowned for its pristine beaches, where visitors can bask in the sun and enjoy the crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf. The island’s diverse marine life makes it a haven for snorkeling and diving enthusiasts. For those who prefer to stay above water, kayaking, paddleboarding, and jet skiing are popular activities. The serene environment and stunning sunsets add to the allure of this coastal paradise. Dining and Shopping Al Marjan Island offers a variety of dining options, from casual eateries to fine dining establishments. The island’s restaurants serve a diverse array of cuisines, catering to different tastes and preferences. Whether you are craving Middle Eastern delicacies, international dishes, or fresh seafood, you will find a restaurant that satisfies your palate. The Al Marjan Island Boulevard and Promenade are popular spots for shopping and dining, offering a mix of retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants in a scenic setting. Recreational Activities

DarGlobal > Newsroom > Blog > Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE > Part 3. For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, Al Marjan Island provides a range of recreational activities. The island’s lush landscapes and well-maintained paths are perfect for jogging, cycling, and leisurely walks. The Al Marjan Island Amphitheater hosts a variety of events and performances, adding to the island’s vibrant atmosphere. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy a round at the nearby Al Hamra Golf Club, which offers a challenging course and stunning views. A Convenient and Accessible Location Al Marjan Island’s location makes it easily accessible from major cities and airports. It is just 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport and 60 minutes from Dubai Mall and the Dubai International Financial Centre. This proximity allows residents and visitors to enjoy the best of both worlds – the tranquility of island living and the excitement of the city. The Astera : A Pinnacle of Luxury and Leisure At the heart of Al Marjan Island’s luxury offerings is The Astera, an exclusive residential project by DarGlobal in collaboration with the legendary automotive brand Aston Martin. The Astera redefines luxury living with its meticulously crafted interiors by Aston Martin, offering an unparalleled blend of elegance, innovation, and craftsmanship. Exceptional Design and Craftsmanship

DarGlobal > Newsroom > Blog > Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE > Part 4. The Astera’s interiors, inspired by Aston Martin’s sleek and dynamic automotive designs, feature elegant lines, premium materials, and a sophisticated aesthetic. Each detail, from fine leather and polished metals to exotic woods, reflects Aston Martin’s legacy of excellence. The residences are designed to harmonize with the surrounding landscape, ensuring breathtaking views from every angle. Residents of The Astera enjoy a bespoke lifestyle experience that embodies the essence of luxury living. World-Class Amenities The Astera offers a range of world-class amenities designed for relaxation and rejuvenation. These include an infinity pool with stunning ocean views, a fitness center, an indoor cinema, a multipurpose hall, a yoga lawn, and a spa. With direct beach access, lush green spaces, and a scenic walk track, every aspect of The Astera is crafted to cater to the discerning few who seek the pinnacle of luxury living. Luxury Resorts and Hotels In addition to The Astera, Al Marjan Island is home to several luxury resorts and hotels, each offering unique experiences and top-notch services. The DoubleTree by Hilton Resort & Spa, Marjan Island Resort & Spa, and the upcoming Ritz-Carlton Ras Al Khaimah, Al Hamra Beach are just a few examples of the high-end accommodations available. These resorts provide a range of amenities, including private beaches, swimming pools, spas, gourmet restaurants, and recreational activities, ensuring a memorable stay for every guest.

DarGlobal > Newsroom > Blog > Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE > Part 5. Al Marjan Island is a testament to the UAE’s vision of creating world-class destinations that offer unparalleled luxury and leisure. From its pristine beaches and luxury resorts to its upcoming attractions like the WYNN Resort and Casino, Al Marjan Island is a haven for those seeking an exceptional lifestyle. The Astera, with its Aston Martin interiors and world-class amenities, epitomizes the island’s commitment to excellence and sophistication. Whether you are looking to invest in a luxury property or simply want to experience the best of what the UAE has to offer, Al Marjan Island is the perfect destination. Discover the luxury and leisure of Al Marjan Island, and experience a lifestyle that is truly extraordinary.

title: Da Vinci Tower, Interiors by Pagani
full_text:
# Da Vinci Tower, Interiors by Pagani

## Project details
- Country: United Arab Emirates
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Property type: Branded Residential Tower
- Status: Completed
- Unit type: 2, 3 & 4-bedrooms
- Area: 800 - 14,768 sqm
- Price: not published
- Developer partner: Pagani

## About
A unique world premiere.
Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residences by Pagani, a branded residential tower in Downtown Dubai, developed by DarGlobal with interiors crafted by Pagani Automobili. An architectural marvel designed to captivate, its striking façade is balanced on a one-of-a-kind geometric structure that creates a dynamic visual effect commanding attention. At its heart lies the pearl, a suspended sphere that adds a touch of wonder to this masterpiece. Rising 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor, the tower offers an unmatched view of the iconic Burj Khalifa and sits just moments from Marasi Business Bay. Its 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences range from 77 to 398 sq m, with opulent interiors by Pagani that embody the meticulous artistry and innovation inspired by Leonardo da Vinci himself. This landmark Pagani residence is a tribute to the timeless genius that shaped both Pagani's vision and these extraordinary homes.

## Key features
- Bespoke Pagani Finishes: Signature interiors featuring premium leather, Italian marble, kinetic chandeliers, carbon fibre accents, and lush wood panelling.
- Seamless Smart technology: Control every aspect of the apartment, from home security, temperature, lighting, music and appliances, all at your fingertips.
- 24/7 Crafted Concierge: From arranging dinner plans to organizing daily housekeeping requests, every need is attended to for residents at all times.
- State-of-the-art Relaxation Area: Enjoy a rooftop pool with unparalleled views, plus a gym with separate male and female steam and sauna relaxation space.

## Amenities
- State-of-the-art Gym
- Rooftop Pool Overlooking Downtown Dubai
- Sauna And Steam Rooms
- 24/7 Concierge Services
- Private Access To The Residences Through Discreet Elevators
- 20% Discount on the Insignia Royal Card

## Why INVEST
Dubai is known to be one of the best places in the world to live, work, vacation, and invest in. Its social, economic and service-friendly environment coupled with its title as the safest city in the world, offers residents and investors numerous advantages over other countries. Dubai is by far one of the most attractive places to invest in, especially real estate, as it is now the new capital of the world.
- 10 year Golden Visa with an investment of 2 million Dirhams
- Attractive Taxation with 0% income Tax | 0% Property Tax
- Ranked First in Safety
- Tourism Hub The top 5 visited cities in the world
- Cosmopolitan Living with more than 120 nationalities currently living in Dubai
- The City of Superlatives Home to the world’s greatest

## Location
Situated directly by the Dubai Canal, overlooking the world’s tallest building Burj Khalifa, and a stone throw away from Marasi Business Bay. A prime location filled with a unique mix of aesthetic residential and commercial towers, attracting the most affluent people from around the world.
- Bespoke Pagani Finishes
- Seamless Smart technology
- 24/7 Crafted Concierge
- State-of-the-art Relaxation Area
- On The Dubai Canal
- The Dubai Mall & Fountains: 9 Min
- The Dubai Marina: 20 Min

## FAQ
Q: Who developed Da Vinci Tower?
A: Da Vinci Tower is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Pagani Automobili and is the world's first Pagani-branded residential development.

Q: Where is Da Vinci Tower located?
A: Da Vinci Tower is located in Downtown Dubai, directly on the Dubai Canal, with views of the Burj Khalifa and moments from Marasi Business Bay.

Q: What types of residences are available at Da Vinci Tower?
A: The tower offers 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences ranging from 77 to 398 sq m, each with private outdoor areas and panoramic views of the canal and Downtown Dubai.

Q: Is Da Vinci Tower really the first Pagani residential project?
A: Yes. Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residential development with interiors by Pagani, applying the brand's design philosophy to luxury living.

Q: What do the Pagani-designed interiors include?
A: Interiors crafted by Pagani feature premium leather, Italian marble, kinetic chandeliers, carbon fibre accents and lush wood panelling.

Q: What amenities does Da Vinci Tower offer?
A: Amenities include a rooftop pool overlooking Downtown Dubai, a state-of-the-art gym, sauna and steam rooms, 24/7 concierge, and private access to the residences through discreet elevators.

Q: How tall is Da Vinci Tower?
A: The tower rises 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor.

Q: How far is Da Vinci Tower from key Dubai landmarks?
A: The Dubai Mall and Fountains are about 9 minutes away, and Dubai Marina is around 20 minutes away.

Q: Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing here?
A: Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE 10-year Golden Visa, and Dubai applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax.

Q: What makes Da Vinci Tower unique?
A: Da Vinci Tower is the world’s first residential development by DarGlobal with interiors designed by Pagani Automobili, bringing the design philosophy of the iconic Italian hypercar manufacturer into luxury living.

# Investor Relations
DarGlobal > Investor Relations > Investor Relations > Overview / Data. Privacy Policy
Introduction
DarGlobal is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit https://www.darglobal.co.uk without disclosing your identity information.
This Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
Acceptance
By using this site, you agree with the DarGlobal Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of DarGlobal website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy.
Information
You may have to register certain information with us to use our services available on this site. The following forms are available on this site to collect personal data that you chose to register to avail of certain services:
EMAIL REGISTRATION Information about DarGlobal, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
CONTACT US The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.darglobal.co.uk, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
RESIDENTIAL UNIT RESERVATION FORM The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned property upon customer request.
CREDIT INFORMATION Relevant information about the credit policy of DarGlobal will be provided to the customer upon request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.
Cookies
Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies

DarGlobal > Investor Relations > Investor Relations > Overview / Data. We may collect personal information from you when you use, including but not limited to, the contact options and e-mail. In addition to the personal information we collect, the website server will automatically recognize and store your internet address. In addition, this website may use cookies. Most web browsers are set by default to accept cookies; however, you may set your browser to either accept or refuse cookies. Cookies help websites keep track of personal preferences and recognize return visitors. The cookies are not designed to collect or store information on you, but to deliver targeted content to you online.
Information Safety​
How safe will my information be?
The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.darglobal.co.uk, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, DarGlobal cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, DarGlobal uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
Information Usage
Who will use this information?
The general rule is that DarGlobal will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the nature of our relationship or the law requires it.

an exclusive gated community and golfing destination

## FAQ
Q: What is AIDA by DarGlobal and what makes this development unique?
A: AIDA is a fully master-planned destination in Muscat, Oman, designed as a city within a city. Developed by DarGlobal, it combines luxury residences, branded hotels, golf courses, nature, and lifestyle amenities in one integrated community.

Q: Where is AIDA located in Oman?
A: AIDA is in Muscat, Oman, about 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, elevated 130 meters above sea level along the coastline, offering scenic views.

Q: Can international buyers own property at AIDA?
A: Yes. AIDA offers 100% foreign ownership within designated investment zones, ideal for investors and second-home buyers.

Q: How can I register my interest or book a viewing at AIDA?
A: You can register your interest through our website or by visiting one of our offices.
If you are outside Oman, the sales team will contact you and arrange the most suitable way to connect.
If you are in Oman or planning a visit, you can visit the office and enjoy a private, one on one site tour, including a visit to the development, the views, and the latest construction updates.

Q: What types of properties are available at AIDA?
A: AIDA offers apartments, luxury villas, hotel residences, and branded or non-branded residences. Explore your options for investment or lifestyle living.

Q: Are there branded residences at AIDA?
A: Yes. AIDA features branded residences in collaboration with internationally recognized brands, including Trump and Marriott.

Q: Does property ownership include golf access?
A: Golf access is available through membership at Trump International Golf Club Oman, subject to application and approval.

Q: Who is developing AIDA in Oman?
A: AIDA is a master plan developed by DarGlobal in partnership with OMRAN, collaborating with global brands such as the Trump Organization and Marriott.

Q: What makes AIDA a city within a city?
A: AIDA offers residential living, hospitality, leisure, wellness, retail, and outdoor experiences all in one destination, allowing residents to live, relax, and socialize without leaving the community.

Q: Is AIDA a gated community in Muscat, Oman?
A: Yes. AIDA is a private, gated community in Muscat offering controlled access, security, and a secure residential environment designed for privacy and peace of mind.

Q: Who is AIDA designed for?
A: AIDA is designed for end users, second-home owners, and international investors seeking a luxury resort lifestyle, long-term value, and globally benchmarked living standards in Oman.

Q: How accessible is AIDA from the region?
A: AIDA is accessible with a 60-minute flight from Dubai and has strong connections to regional and international destinations.

Q: What views are available from properties at AIDA?
A: Homes at AIDA offer sea views, golf course views, or valley/wadi views. The master plan integrates natural landscapes with parks and elevated viewpoints.

Q: How is nature integrated into the master plan?
A: AIDA features landscaped parks, hiking and cycling trails, and outdoor adventure zones, blending luxury living with Oman’s natural environment.

Q: Is there a golf course at AIDA?
A: Yes, there is an 18-hole trump championship golf course.

Q: What is the AIDA Residence Club?
A: The AIDA Residence Club offers wellness, leisure, dining, and community facilities exclusively for residents.

Q: Is AIDA suitable for families?
A: Yes. AIDA is designed for families, with amenities and spaces suited for all age groups.

Q: Does owning property at AIDA provide residency benefits?
A: Eligible property ownership gives access to lifetime residency in Oman, subject to regulations.

Q: Are financing and payment plans available at AIDA?
A: Buyers can access mortgage solutions and structured payment plans, typically linked to construction milestones.

Q: Can I rent out my property at AIDA?
A: Yes. Approved properties can be rented on a short-term basis, with professional management services available.

Q: What amenities are available at AIDA?
A: Amenities include swimming pools, parks, wellness and fitness centers, restaurants, kids’ play areas, outdoor cinemas, and adventure zones.

Q: Are properties at AIDA managed?
A: Yes. Selected residences and hotel units are fully managed, including Trump International Hotel and Trump Cliff Villas, for hassle-free ownership.

Q: Is rental management available at AIDA?
A: Yes. Owners can opt for rental management services to generate income from eligible units.

Q: What are the key residences at AIDA?
A: AIDA includes Trump Golf Villas, Trump Cliff Villas, Fairway Villas, The Great Escape, Marriott Residences and more, each offering unique designs, views, and lifestyle benefits.

# Les Vagues by Elie Saab

## Project details
- Country: Qatar
- Location: Doha, Qatar
- Property type: Branded Residential Complex
- Status: Under Development
- Unit type: 1, 2 & 3-bedrooms
- Area: 84 - 383 sqm
- Price: not published
- Developer partner: DarGlobal

## About
A Paradise by the Shore.
Les Vagues by Elie Saab is a branded seafront residential complex on Qetaifan Island North, Doha, developed by DarGlobal. One-, two-, and three-bedroom residences ranging from 86 to 389 sqm feature Elie Saab interiors in cream and grey tones, with marble, bronze, and premium stone finishes. The island destination includes private beaches, a marina, a water park, and an 18-hole golf course.

## Key features
- Easy access to all tourist, shopping, and entertainment landmarks in Qatar
- 30-Minutes away from Hamad International Airport, the top rated airport in the world.
- Minutes away from Qatar's Largest Theme Park
- 7 km of Stunning Beach Shoreline & a Vibrant Marina
- A Signature 18-hole golf Course and Clubhouse
- Luxurious 5-star Amenities and Hotels

## Amenities
- State Of The Art Fitness Center
- Infinity Swimming Pool
- 4 Personal Elevators, Inclusive Of A Service Elevator To All Floors
- Lounges And Lobby Areas: Furniture Designed And Selected By Elie Saab
- 24hrs Reception Desk
- Luxury Retail
- Parking For All Units
- Landscaped Community Courtyard With Seaviews

## Why INVEST
Within a short period of time, the State of Qatar has made great strides. It has championed culture, education, healthcare, infrastructure and technology, resulting in a nation that is tolerant, diverse, and rich in experiences. As a fertile country along the coast of the Arabian Gulf, rich in natural reserves and human talent, Qatar is emerging to become one of the most sought-after investment opportunities in the region.
- Golden Visa with an investment of $200,000
- Tax incentives with 0% property tax and so much more
- A Stable Economy with the highest GDP per capita in the world
- 100% foreign business ownership
- One of the Safest countries in the world
- Welcoming around 40 million tourists to the world’s best airport
- Quality Healthcare for all
- Ranked 1st in the Arab Region in Education

## Location
A man-made paradise on earth, Qetaifan Island North is 1.3 million square meters of picturesque luxuriousness destined to become an internationally recognized landmark and a symbol of Qatar’s burgeoning future.
- Easy access to all tourist, shopping, and entertainment landmarks in Qatar
- 30-Minutes away from Hamad International Airport, the top rated airport in the world.: 30 Min
- Minutes away from Qatar's Largest Theme Park
- 7 km of Stunning Beach Shoreline & a Vibrant Marina
- A Signature 18-hole golf Course and Clubhouse
- Luxurious 5-star Amenities and Hotels

## FAQ
Q: What is Les Vagues by Elie Saab?
A: Les Vagues by Elie Saab is a branded seafront residential complex on Qetaifan Island North, Doha, developed by DarGlobal. Elie Saab provided the interior design for each residence and the building's common areas, bringing the Lebanese fashion house's signature aesthetic of cream, marble, bronze, and premium stone to one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments.

Q: What did Elie Saab design at Les Vagues?
A: Elie Saab was responsible for the full interior design of each residence, as well as the building's lounges and lobby areas, personally selecting all furniture for the common spaces. The design palette centres on cream and grey tones, shiny metal finishes, bronze, marble, and premium stone, reflecting the couture-level craftsmanship the house is known for.

Q: What unit types and sizes are available at Les Vagues?
A: Les Vagues offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences ranging from 86 to 389 sqm on Qetaifan Island North. Units are served by four personal elevators per building including a service elevator, and sit within a gated seafront complex with an infinity pool and landscaped sea-view courtyard.

Q: When will Les Vagues by Elie Saab be completed?
A: Les Vagues is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. Construction is actively underway on Qetaifan Island North. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

Q: Where is Les Vagues located?
A: Les Vagues is on Qetaifan Island North, a 1.3 million sqm man-made island off the coast of Doha, Qatar. The development is 30 minutes from Hamad International Airport, within minutes of Qatar's largest theme park, and sits alongside 7 km of beach shoreline, a vibrant marina, and a signature 18-hole golf course and clubhouse.

Q: What amenities does Les Vagues offer within the building?
A: Building amenities include an infinity swimming pool, state-of-the-art fitness centre, four personal elevators per unit including a service elevator, 24-hour reception, luxury retail, covered parking for all units, and a landscaped community courtyard with sea views. Lobby and lounge furniture was designed and personally selected by Elie Saab.

Q: What lifestyle facilities does Qetaifan Island North offer?
A: Qetaifan Island North delivers 7 km of beach shoreline, private beaches, a marina, world-class boating facilities, boutique shopping, a water park, a winter garden, a signature 18-hole golf course and clubhouse, and 5-star hotels and amenities, functioning as a fully self-contained luxury destination in Doha.

Q: Why invest in Qatar real estate?
A: Qatar offers a Golden Visa with an investment of $200,000, 0% property tax, 100% foreign business ownership, and one of the world's highest GDP per capita figures. Qatar hosted the FIFA World Cup 2022 and processes approximately 40 million tourists annually through Hamad International Airport, consistently rated the world's best.

Q: Is Les Vagues by Elie Saab a good investment?
A: Les Vagues sits on a purpose-built island destination with a diversified lifestyle offering, in one of the Gulf's most politically stable and tax-efficient markets. Elie Saab-branded residences occupy a distinct position in Doha's luxury market, and branded product consistently commands a premium over comparable unbranded stock. Buyers should seek independent investment advice on suitability.

Q: How do I register interest or buy at Les Vagues by Elie Saab?
A: Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

# Marea, Interiors by Missoni

## Project details
- Country: Spain
- Location: Cortesin, Costa del Sol, Spain
- Property type: Branded Residential Complex
- Status: Under Development
- Unit type: 2, 3 and 4 bedroom
- Area: 147 -382 sqm
- Price: not published
- Developer partner: Missoni

## About
In the heart of Cortesin Gated Community
Marea, Interiors by Missoni is an exclusive gated residential community within the Finca Cortesin estate, Cortesin, Costa Del Sol, developed by DarGlobal. The collection offers two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences ranging from 223 to 553 sqm, with Missoni-designed interiors and a 270-degree panorama spanning from Marbella to Gibraltar and the mountains of Morocco.

## Key features
- The Beach
- Casares Village
- Santa Maria Polo Club
- Polo Valley Sotogrande
- Gibraltar airport
- Malaga Airport

## Amenities
- Gated Community With Private Entrance
- 24/7 Premium Security Services
- 1 Parking Lot For 2-bedroom Units

- 24-hour concierge
- 1 storage space per unit
- Community garden
- Infinity pool
- State-of-the-art gym
- Tennis courts
- Hanging observation deck
- Children’s playground
- Children’s swimming pool
- Children’s splash area

## Why INVEST
Spain is considered one of the most attractive countries for real estate investments on the European continent, especially in the south. Along its 8,000km of coastal seafront lies Costa Del Sol, an ideal location for those looking for a vacation home, a place to retire, or open a new business. Its privileged geographic location is ideal for living and international business, as it connects Europe, South America and the African continent. All with the benefit of a golden visa in the heart of the EU.
- Robust tourism industry contributes to high rental returns.
- Lowest interest rates in the Eurozone, between 3 – 5%
- Highest ROI in Europe
- High Connectivity high-speed train connections to Costa Del Sol
- Ranked 4th in work-life balance.
- Welcoming Country most open regulations for foreign investments
- Mediterranean Climate all year round
- A Tourism & Environmental Hub
- Growing Economy The 15th largest economy in the world

## Location
Marea by Missoni’s prime location within the exclusive Finca Cortesin gated community offers a unique blend of luxury and privacy, surrounded by stunning Mediterranean landscapes. Enjoy the finest amenities and unparalleled access to world-class facilities, making it an ideal destination for discerning buyers seeking an exceptional living experience.
- The Beach: 5 Min
- Casares Village: 14 Min
- Santa Maria Polo Club: 15 Min
- Polo Valley Sotogrande: 25 Min
- Gibraltar airport: 45 Min
- Malaga Airport: 50 Min

## FAQ
Q: What is Marea, Interiors by Missoni?
A: Marea, Interiors by Missoni is an exclusive branded residential community within the Finca Cortesin gated estate on Costa Del Sol, Spain, developed by DarGlobal. Missoni provided the interior design across the collection of two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences, which overlook the Mediterranean Sea and an elite golf course set against a 270-degree panorama.

Q: What did Missoni design at Marea?
A: Missoni's design team was responsible for the interiors throughout the residences, bringing the Italian fashion house's signature approach to colour, pattern, and material quality into kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The brand-led interiors give each residence a distinctive identity beyond standard luxury specification.

Q: What unit types and sizes are available at Marea?
A: Marea offers two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences ranging from 223 to 553 sqm. The community is a gated complex within the Finca Cortesin estate, with each unit designed for the panoramic sea and mountain views the site commands.

Q: When will Marea, Interiors by Missoni be completed?
A: Phase 1 of Marea completed in 2024. The full development is scheduled for completion in December 2027. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

Q: Where is Marea, Interiors by Missoni located?
A: Marea sits within the Finca Cortesin gated estate in Cortesin, Costa Del Sol. The beach is 5 minutes away, Marbella is 20 minutes, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande are a 20-minute drive, Santa Maria Polo Club is 15 minutes, Gibraltar Airport is 45 minutes, and Malaga Airport is 50 minutes.

Q: What is the 270-degree view at Marea?
A: The site's elevation and orientation give residences an unobstructed 270-degree panorama that stretches from Marbella along the Costa Del Sol coastline, across to Gibraltar, and continues to the mountains of Morocco on the African continent, with the Mediterranean Sea and Finca Cortesin golf course directly below.

Q: What amenities does Marea, Interiors by Missoni offer?
A: Amenities include a gated community with private entrance and 24/7 premium security, 24-hour concierge, infinity pool, state-of-the-art gym, tennis courts, hanging observation deck, community garden, children's playground, children's swimming pool, children's splash area, and dedicated parking and storage per unit.

Q: What is the Finca Cortesin estate?
A: Finca Cortesin is one of Costa Del Sol's most prestigious private estates, home to the five-star Finca Cortesin Hotel and Golf Club. Marea's location within this estate gives residents access to the exclusivity and security of one of Spain's most recognised luxury addresses on the Costa del Sol.

Q: Why invest in Costa Del Sol property near Cortesin?
A: Costa Del Sol combines Spain's highest real estate ROI in Europe with Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, a Mediterranean climate year-round, and strong tourism that supports rental demand. Cortesin's proximity to Marbella, Sotogrande, and Gibraltar positions it within a corridor that draws international buyers and second-home investors consistently.

Q: How do I register interest or buy at Marea, Interiors by Missoni?
A: Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

## Project details
- Country: Oman
- Location: Aida, Oman
- Part of: AIDA
- Category: hotel rooms
- Property type: Branded Residential Complex
- Status: Under Development
- Unit type: 1, 2, 3 Bedrooms
- Area: 60 - 194 sqm
- Price: not published
- Developer partner: Marriott

## About
Come Home to Wonderful
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a branded residential complex at AIDA, Muscat, developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC using the Marriott name under license. The development offers fully furnished one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments from 60 to 194 sqm, with à la carte services including concierge, reception, doorman, lobby, and valet. Located 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. DISCLAIMER NOTE (to be placed in accordance with brand guidelines): Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed or sold by Marriott International, Inc. or its affiliates. Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC uses the Marriott marks under a license from Marriott, which has not confirmed the accuracy of any of the statements or representations made herein.

## Key features
- Nikki-Beach (2024)
- Al Bustan Palace, Ritz-Carlton Muscat
- Shangri-La
- Jumeirah Muscat Bay Hotel
- Muscat International Airport

## Amenities
- Championship Golf Course
- Plazas, Cafes & Restaurants
- Wellness Centers
- Fitness Center
- Promenades
- Hiking Trails
- Mountain Bike Trails
- Luxury Hotels
- Outdoor Landscapes
- Running Trail
- Viewing Decks
- Private Beach Enclave
- Parks
- Swimming Pools
- Children's Splash Areas
- Club House

## Why Invest
Oman is quickly becoming one of the most prominent commercial and cultural hubs in the region and is rapidly becoming a prime investment destination due to its attractive benefits. From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive.
- Life-time Residency Visa for owners on projects in the ITC.
- Upcoming railway project connecting UAE to Muscat, Oman.
- 100% Freehold Ownership for all nationalities.
- 0% Personal Income tax.
- 0% Capital Gains tax.
- 0% Inheritance tax Oman applies the inheritance laws of the investor’s country of origin, not local laws.
- 25 years exemption from corporate income taxes for special economic/free zone
- Stable and Growing Economy Current inflation rate is one of the lowest globally.
- One Of the Safest Countries in the world.
- Ideal Location easy access to the gulf, the Indian subcontinent and Africa.
- A Tourism Hub High potential for growth, projected earnings of 22.5bn USD by 2040.
- Cosmopolitan Home to a vibrant expat and foreign ownership community with over 100 nationalities.
- The Quality of Life Index by Numbeo ranked Oman 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in 2023.
- Saudi-Oman Highway: Cuts travel by 16 hours, driving tourism and investment.
- Exclusive mortgage program in Oman for resident and non-resident buyers, designed to enhance real estate returns.

## Location
Located in Muscat and just 25 minutes from the international airport, AIDA rises 130 metres above sea level as a city within a city, combining nature, hospitality, and a championship golf destination.
- Nikki-Beach (2024)
- Al Bustan Palace, Ritz-Carlton Muscat
- Shangri-La
- Jumeirah Muscat Bay Hotel
- Muscat International Airport

## FAQ
Q: What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
A: Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.

Q: Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
A: The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.

Q: What unit types and sizes are available?
A: The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.

Q: What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
A: Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.

Q: What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
A: The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.

Q: When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
A: Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.

Q: Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
A: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.

Q: What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
A: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

Q: Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
A: Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.

Q: How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
A: Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

# Aston Martin
DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > Overview. Aston Martin is a DarGlobal collaboration partner. aston martin Aston Martin Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
Aston Martin partnered with DarGlobal on The Astera, a Ras Al Khaimah development that brings the marque's first residential project to the Gulf. This landmark collaboration marks Aston Martin's entry into branded living, translating decades of automotive craftsmanship into architecture. Two icons. Bound by a shared obsession with precision and craft. The result? Legendary performance, at home on one of the Gulf's most coveted coastlines. It's more than a residence, it's a legacy you can live in. It's power, poured into place.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > Related projects. Projects with Aston Martin: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin (Ras Al Khaimah, UAE); Top of the Astera (Al Marjan Island, RAK, UAE).

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: Who developed The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin? A: The Astera is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Aston Martin, marking the British marque's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council).

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: Where is The Astera located? A: The Astera sits on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, near the Wynn Resort with direct beachfront access, about an hour's drive from Dubai.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: What types of residences are available at The Astera? A: The development offers one, two and three-bedroom apartments alongside three-bedroom villas, each finished with Aston Martin's signature interior design.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: Is this Aston Martin's first real estate project in the Middle East? A: Yes. The Astera marks Aston Martin's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council), following earlier design partnerships in the United States and Japan.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: What is the value of The Astera development? A: The Astera carries a Gross Development Value of approximately AED 900 million, around £200 million.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: When is The Astera expected to be completed? A: Construction is underway following the appointment of Stromek Emirates Foundations for shoring, excavation and piling works, with completion due by December 2028.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: What amenities does The Astera offer? A: Residents have access to a private beach, an infinity pool with ocean views, a scenic walking track, an indoor cinema, a fitness centre, a spa, a yoga lawn, a children's play area and a multipurpose hall.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: What makes the Aston Martin interiors distinct? A: Aston Martin's design team applies the marque's signature blend of sophistication, precision craftsmanship and high-performance design language to every residence's interior.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: How far is The Astera from Dubai? A: Dubai is approximately an hour's drive from Al Marjan Island, keeping The Astera close to the city while offering a secluded beachfront setting.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Aston Martin > FAQ. Q: Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing at The Astera? A: Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE's 10-year Golden Visa, and the UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax.

Fendi Casa partnered with DarGlobal on Azure Oceanfront Villas, an AIDA, Oman development that carries a century of Roman design heritage into residential interiors. This landmark collaboration marks Fendi Casa's continued expansion beyond fashion, translating the house's legacy of craftsmanship into a place to live. Two houses. One built on decades of couture, one on decades of skyline. The result? Elegance, tradition, and experimentation, folded into every interior surface. It's more than a villa, it's a house history you can inhabit. It's Rome, brought to the sea.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Fendi Casa > Related projects. Projects with Fendi Casa: DarGlobal Mansions Interiors by Fendi Casa (Wadi Safar | Riyadh | Saudi Arabia); Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa (AIDA | Oman).

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Fendi Casa > FAQ. Q: Where are the Azure Oceanfront Villas located? A: The villas sit within AIDA, DarGlobal's hilltop master development on the coast near Muscat, Oman.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Fendi Casa > FAQ. Q: What is Fendi Casa? A: Fendi Casa is the home and interiors division of the Italian luxury house FENDI, founded in Rome in 1925.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Fendi Casa > FAQ. Q: What does the FENDI name bring to these villas? A: FENDI brings a century of Italian craftsmanship and design innovation to residential interiors for the first time through this collaboration.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Fendi Casa > FAQ. Q: Who has led FENDI's creative direction over the years? A: Creative direction has passed through the Fendi family, Karl Lagerfeld from 1965 to 2019, Silvia Venturini Fendi, Kim Jones from 2020 to 2024, and Delfina Delettrez Fendi on jewellery since 2020.

DarGlobal > Collaborations > Fendi Casa > FAQ. Q: What makes this collaboration distinct? A: It marks Fendi Casa's entry into branded residential real estate, bringing FENDI's century of Italian luxury heritage to an oceanfront setting within AIDA.

This landmark collaboration marks Lamborghini's expression of performance engineering translated into finely crafted residential detail. Two engines. One built for the road, one built for living. # DarGlobal and Art District Real Estate Development Announce MAD, Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District
DarGlobal > Newsroom > News > DarGlobal and Art District Real Estate Development Announce MAD, Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District > Part 1. DarGlobal (LSE: DAR), the London-listed luxury real estate developer, in partnership with Art District Real Estate Development, today announced the start of the collaboration to launch and develop MAD, Muscat Marine, Art & Digital District, a transformative new coastal destination that integrates oceanfront living, luxury hospitality, culture-led enterprise, and future-focused finance and digital industries. Located along Oman’s picturesque coastline, the MAD project spans over 1.5 million square meters with a gross development value of approximately OMR 1.6 billion (USD 4.2 Billion) for all development phases which will span over 12 years. It is designed to elevate the Sultanate’s global standing by merging sea-view living, luxury hospitality, cultural expression, and future financial and digital sectors into one unified ecosystem. Conceived as a multi-destination city, MAD brings together luxury residential communities, cultural venues, world-class marinas, curated retail, next-generation finance and business parks, and premium hotels. The district will invite affluent travelers, global investors, art collectors, tech founders and creative entrepreneurs to live, work and connect within a single, seamless experience rooted in Oman’s maritime identity and economic vision. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, said: “MAD represents a defining step in how Oman’s coastline will be experienced and how its future economy will emerge. Together with Art District Real Estate development, we are building a destination that goes beyond real estate to empower enterprise, attract global talent, support cultural production and unlock new economic value. MAD is a new gateway for Oman, one inspired by the sea and shaped by innovation.”

DarGlobal > Newsroom > News > DarGlobal and Art District Real Estate Development Announce MAD, Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District > Part 2. At the heart of MAD is a commitment to support Oman’s diversification goals, aligning with the nation’s strategy to grow culture, tourism, technology and high-value finance and investment sectors. The district will host private marinas for mansions, international art exhibitions, digital incubators, a financial center, and a cultural calendar of global events, positioning Muscat as a hub for marine adventure, cultural exchange and financial and digital creativity. This project reflects Oman’s confidence in building industries of the future. MAD showcases how strategic development can preserve our maritime heritage while embracing the opportunities of global innovation. It will attract investment, cultivate talent, and create enduring cultural and economic impact for generations to come.” A defining feature of MAD is the integration of a district-wide digital economy, enabling a new model of property, culture, and enterprise. The development introduces digital licensing, asset exchange, and ecosystem rewards, supporting business formation and investment pathways for global entrepreneurs and investors. “We are creating value beyond physical spaces,” added El Chaar . “MAD is an ecosystem where creators, innovators and investors meet; not only to live or visit, but to participate. That participation defines the future of real estate, and we are proud to shape it in Oman.This partnership demonstrates what Oman stands for; cultural leadership, responsible innovation and global investment confidence. MAD is a testament to what is possible when heritage and ambition come together.”

Legendary Collaboration
The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, by DarGlobal. ## Why Invest
Ras Al Khaimah, the fourth-largest emirate in the United Arab Emirates, is home to the newly opened RAK Market, which launched just two years ago. Some of the most desirable areas include Al Marjan Island, Al Hamra Village, and Mina Al Arab. Al Marjan Island's development strategy focuses on attracting a broad spectrum of international investors by offering luxurious amenities, serene ocean views, and a resort-style community. The emphasis on beachfront luxury, combined with the promise of high returns, positions Al Marjan Island as a prime destination for investment in the UAE's real estate market. - Branded Residences: Achieve higher returns with price premiums of 30% to 200% due to perceived quality, prestige, and superior services, attracting high-net-worth buyers

## Location
The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is located on Al Marjan Island, a shining gem on the coastline of Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. This remarkable man-made island offers a luxurious retreat surrounded by pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters. Boasting an array of world-class resorts, upscale residences, and vibrant leisure attractions.


## FAQ
Q: What is The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin?
A: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, developed by DarGlobal. Aston Martin's design team applied the brand's precision and craftsmanship to each unit, producing a collection of one- to three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beach villas directly on the water's edge.

Q: What unit types and sizes are available at The Astera?
A: The Astera offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beachfront villas ranging from 61 to 265 sqm. All units feature Aston Martin-designed interiors and sit on Al Marjan Island with direct beach access.

Q: What did Aston Martin design at The Astera?
A: Aston Martin's design team was responsible for the interiors of every residence, applying the brand's approach to precision, material quality, and artisanal craftsmanship to kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The collaboration integrates cutting-edge design with the timeless finishes associated with the Aston Martin brand.

Q: When will The Astera be completed?
A: The Astera is under development with handover scheduled for December 2028. DarGlobal is the master developer responsible for delivery on Al Marjan Island. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

Q: Where exactly is The Astera located?
A: The Astera is on Al Marjan Island, a man-made island off the Ras Al Khaimah coastline, 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. It sits approximately 5 minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East.

Q: What amenities does The Astera offer?
A: Amenities include direct beach access, an infinity pool, spa, sauna, pool bar, fitness centre, indoor cinema, yoga lawn, multipurpose hall, children's play area, and premium 24/7 security. Beach villas offer private access to the shoreline directly from the residence.

Q: Is The Astera a good investment in Ras Al Khaimah?
A: Al Marjan Island is an emerging market where average apartment capital values rose approximately 35% in a single year. Branded residences historically command price premiums of 30 to 200% over comparable unbranded stock, and the Wynn Resort announcement has been directly linked to market price doubling over two years. Buyers should seek independent investment advice.

Q: What is the UAE Golden Visa benefit for buyers at The Astera?
A: Buyers investing 2 million AED or more in UAE real estate may apply for a 10-year Golden Visa. The UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax, providing a tax-efficient holding environment for both resident and international buyers.

Q: How does the Wynn Resort affect Al Marjan Island property values?
A: The announcement of the Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East, has been directly linked to a doubling of market prices over the past two years. The resort will be approximately 5 minutes from The Astera and is expected to drive further tourism and rental demand for beachfront properties on the island.

Q: How do I register interest or buy at The Astera?
A: Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

# Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai

## Project details
- Country: United Arab Emirates
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Property type: Branded Hotel & Residential Tower
- Status: Under Development
- Unit type: 1, 2, 3 Bedroom Apartments & 4 Bedroom Duplex Penthouses
- Area: 764 - 7,720 sqm
- Price: not published
- Developer partner: Trump

## About
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.

## Key features
- Trump International Hotel & Tower: A five-star luxury hotel, joining the legacy of Trump organization most iconic hotels. Featuring fine dining, world-class entertainment, and true luxury at every turn.
- The Trump, Members-Only Club: The Trump Members-Only Club brings together wellness, business, and the timeless atmosphere of a classic private club. Access is limited to members only through an annual fee, with residents receiving priority access.
- The Trump Residences: Featuring 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, the residences dominate the skyline — with every unit offering a view. Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the highest outdoor pool in the world.

## Amenities
- Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world
- State of the art gym
- Owners lounge
- Kids play area

## Location
Located on Sheikh zayed road, right at the entrance of downtown, you are connected to it all without the congestion. Giving you direct access to Downtown, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Fountains.
- Trump International Hotel & Tower
- The Trump, Members-Only Club
- The Trump Residences

## FAQ
Q: What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
A: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.

Q: What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
A: The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.

Q: When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
A: The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.

Q: Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
A: The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.

Q: Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
A: Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.

Q: What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
A: The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

Q: What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
A: Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.

Q: Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
A: The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.

Q: How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
A: It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.

Q: How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
A: Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

faqs.a: The Trump Private Club is a resident-focused facility within the tower offering fine dining, a cigar lounge, meeting rooms, a gym, a yoga zone, swimming pool pool, kids pool, jacuzzi, and 24/7 concierge services.

faqs.q: What amenities does Trump Tower Jeddah offer?
faqs.a: Amenities include the Trump Private Club, 24/7 concierge, fine dining, and cigar lounge, meeting rooms, gym, yoga zone, pool, kids' pool, jacuzzi, and uninterrupted Red Sea views from one of the tallest towers in Jeddah Corniche.

faqs.q: Why invest in Jeddah real estate under Saudi Vision 2030?
faqs.a: Saudi Arabia offers 0% income tax and capital gains tax, a 30-year corporate tax exemption, and premium Saudi residency eligibility for investments of 4 million SAR or more. The SAR is pegged to the US dollar, and Saudi Arabia hosts Expo 2030 and the 2034 FIFA World Cup.

faqs.q: What makes Trump Tower Jeddah's location on the Corniche valuable?

faqs.q: How do I register interest or buy a unit at Trump Tower Jeddah?
faqs.a: Buyers can register interest, book a unit, explore available units via the online residence navigator, or download the brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current pricing and payment plan terms on request.

Experience the Miami Vibe.

Q: What is Urban Oasis by Missoni?
A: Urban Oasis by Missoni is a completed branded residential tower on the Dubai Canal, developed by DarGlobal.
