Q: What did Missoni design at Urban Oasis?
A: Missoni's design team was responsible for the interiors throughout Urban Oasis, applying the brand's approach to colour, pattern, and material quality across living spaces, bedrooms, and kitchens. The design concept draws on the energy of Miami Beach living, translated into a canal-facing Dubai address.

Q: Is Urban Oasis by Missoni sold out?
A: Yes. Urban Oasis by Missoni is sold out. The project is fully completed and delivered. Buyers interested in current DarGlobal projects or potential resale units can contact DarGlobal directly through darglobal.co.uk.

Q: Where is Urban Oasis by Missoni located?
A: The tower sits directly on the Dubai Canal, placing it 5 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from Jumeirah Beach, and 17 minutes from both Dubai International Airport and Dubai Marina. The canal-front position gives residents constant waterfront access alongside immediate connectivity to the city's key destinations.

Q: What unit types are available at Urban Oasis by Missoni?
A: The tower comprises one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences alongside penthouses accessed via private elevators. Units feature closed kitchens, expansive bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, and 360-degree views of the Dubai Canal and city skyline. The project is sold out and fully handed over.

Q: What amenities does Urban Oasis by Missoni offer?
A: Amenities include an infinity pool, cutting-edge gym, grand entrance lobby, ground-floor retail, covered parking, and 24/7 concierge services. The tower sits directly on the Dubai Canal, providing immediate waterfront access as a lifestyle amenity in itself.

Q: What was the investment case for Urban Oasis by Missoni?
A: Urban Oasis by Missoni offered a Missoni-branded waterfront address on the Dubai Canal, a corridor that has seen strong capital appreciation as Business Bay has matured into one of Dubai's premier residential and commercial districts. Dubai offers 0% income tax, 0% property tax, and a 10-year Golden Visa with qualifying investments of 2 million AED or more.

Q: How does Urban Oasis by Missoni compare to other branded projects on the Dubai Canal?
A: Urban Oasis is one of few completed, fully delivered branded residences with direct canal frontage in Business Bay. Its combination of an Italian fashion brand interior, private elevator penthouses, and 360-degree canal and city views placed it in a distinct segment of the Dubai branded residence market.

Q: Can I buy a resale unit at Urban Oasis by Missoni?
A: As the project is sold out at the developer level, any available units would be on the secondary market. DarGlobal can advise on current availability or direct interested buyers to appropriate channels. Contact the team at darglobal.co.uk for further information.

Q: What other DarGlobal branded residence projects are available in Dubai?
A: DarGlobal has developed multiple branded residential projects in Dubai and across the region, including Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai and DG1 on the Dubai Canal. Visit darglobal.co.uk to explore the current portfolio and available projects.

full_text:
# Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa
Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa — a DarGlobal One of One residence in AIDA, Muscat, Oman. Type: villa. 5 bedrooms. Partner brand: Fendi Casa. Price: not published (enquire with DarGlobal).

Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of five-bedroom residences, suspended 130 meters above the sea, inside AIDA, Oman’s most prestigious gated coastal community.
Interiors by FENDI Casa.
Nothing in front of you. Nothing above you.
Only the horizon.


## First row to nature’s beauty. Nineteen pieces above the sea
Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of five-bedroom residences, suspended 130 meters above the sea, inside AIDA, Oman’s most prestigious gated coastal community.
Interiors by FENDI Casa.
Nothing in front of you. Nothing above you.
Only the horizon.

## A gated enclave within a gated community
Azure occupies the highest and most discreet zone within AIDA.
Privately gated.
Limited in number.
Built for distance.
Designed for discretion.

## Interiors by FENDI Casa
Interiors reflect the brand’s signature approach to craftsmanship and detail, combining refined materials with a contemporary design language.
Custom furnishings, sculptural elements, and curated finishes create spaces that are both functional and expressive.

## THE VILLAS SPECS
Five-bedroom villas designed with a focus on proportion, functionality, and material quality.

Key features include:

• Branded interiors by FENDI Casa  
• Open-plan living and dining areas  
• Bespoke finishes and materials  
• Expansive glazing to maximise natural light  
• Carefully planned layouts for privacy and flow  

Each villa is composed to balance design clarity with everyday usability.

## LIVING EXPERIENCE
Each residence includes private outdoor spaces designed as extensions of the interior.

• Expansive terraces  
• Landscaped gardens  
• Infinity-edge swimming pools  

These elements are positioned to create continuity between indoor and outdoor living.

## THE VIEWS
All villas are oriented toward the sea, ensuring uninterrupted views of the horizon.
There are no structures above or in front, allowing full visual openness and a direct connection to the surrounding landscape.

## LOCATION
AIDA is a gated clifftop community overlooking the Gulf of Oman, spanning over 4.3 million sqm.

The city integrates residential, golfing, and hospitality components, including:

• Trump International Golf Club  
• Luxury hotels and resorts  
• Beaches and coastal access  
• Wellness and outdoor facilities  

Located approximately 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, AIDA offers both accessibility and seclusion.

## FLOOR PLAN
For floor plans, please join the waiting list.

# Painite Villas Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
Painite Villas Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini — a DarGlobal One of One residence in Benahavís, Spain. Type: villa. 6 bedrooms. Partner brand: Automobili Lamborghini. Price: not published (enquire with DarGlobal).

The Painite Villas are luxurious six-bedroom villas located in the south of Spain, featuring exclusive Sky Car Lift technology by Automobili Lamborghini and offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea.

## SIDE BY SIDE
The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space.

##  PRIVATE SKY CAR LIFT
The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea.

## THE VILLA
The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury.

## THE VIEWS
The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity.

## THE AMENITIES
Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.

## LOCATION
The Painite Villas are located in Tierra Viva in Marbella, one of the most affluent locations around the world. Home to the most stylish clubs, restaurants and hotels, as well as, shopping areas, exclusive marinas and breathtaking beaches. The villas are precisely nestled in the hills, only minutes away from the shores and in close proximity to 9 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banus.

# THE ALBERT HALL MANSION
THE ALBERT HALL MANSION — a DarGlobal One of One residence in London, United Kingdom. Type: mansion. Price: not published (enquire with DarGlobal).



## Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

## A prestigious Address
The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

## Location
Albert Hall Mansions is ideally located in one of London's most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic building offers breathtaking views and an exclusive address, balancing the vibrant energy of city life with the tranquility of a refined residential area. Situated in South Kensington, residents have access to Hyde Park, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the luxury shopping of Knightsbridge, along with an array of fine dining, shopping, and cultural attractions. This location is perfect for those seeking a sophisticated and dynamic lifestyle.
